item: Candidate-sources export leaves out the app's own non-web channels (field analysis 2026-11)
summary: Wikipedia-edition rows and a hazard row were the top candidates on all four field instances (11 of the 15 that passed the report's evidence rule). Rows of the provenance classes hazard, law, wikipedia, newsletter and statistics (the source-quality export's exempt set) are counted in left_out.not_a_web_source instead of listed; cited and web outlets stay. Export-only.
